packageRules.description: Group packages released in lockstep from the Effect monorepo. Renovate's own `group:monorepos` preset matches on `matchSourceUrls`, which does not work here: `monorepo.json` lists `Effect-TS/effect-smol`, while the published packages point at `Effect-TS/effect`. Matching on package names instead keeps the group working no matter where the sources move. Still needed as of the 4.0.0 stable release: https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/pull/44751, which adds `Effect-TS/effect` to the preset, is not merged yet.
